g.text: Right turn: actual mean yaw velocity
Microduck: paired post-training from one shared initial policy
2,000 additional PPO updates per model | Same default evaluation environment | 3 evaluation seeds x 32 envs x 10 seconds per command
Dots: evaluation-seed means. Error bars: sample standard deviation across those 3 seeds (not confidence intervals).
Post-training seeds 0 and 1 share the same initial checkpoint; these are not independent pretraining replicates.
